# Mr. Earthling

> Mr. Earthling sells naturally fermented kimchi made the Indian way. Orders are taken on WhatsApp only, through https://mrearthling.com.

## Products
- Kimchi, 250 g jar (available now), ₹330 launch price (usually ₹500), delivered in Bengaluru, dispatched the next day, delivery charged at actual cost via Porter or Swiggy Genie. Vegan, cruelty free and climate conscious. Naturally fermented, live probiotic cultures, no artificial preservatives. Ingredients: napa cabbage, carrots, radish, gochujang, rice paste, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, salt, pear or apple. Contains soy and wheat (gluten).
- Lavender rice, microgreens, dehydrated mushrooms and dehydrated chillies (coming soon, not yet available).

## Story
- Every jar is made by a homemaker who, later in life, is starting her first business on the way to full independence.

## How to order
- Tap "Get the Jar" on https://mrearthling.com. It opens a WhatsApp chat with the order message filled in. There is no checkout on the website.
